College Research Project • Academic Year 2025-2026

Chemical Awareness

An academic initiative analyzing the chemical formulations of everyday consumer hygiene, cosmetic, and household cleaning products. We bridge the gap between complex chemical nomenclature and transparent toxicity evaluation.

Explore Products Survey Results

Explore by Product Category

Select any of the eight consumer product categories to view cataloged formulations, chemical functions, and health risk profiles.

1. Shampoo / Conditioner

Clarifying surfactants (SLS), conditioning agents, silicones, and synthetic fragrance additives.

Browse Formulations →

2. Body Wash / Bar Soap

Saponified plant oils, synthetic foaming surfactants, antibacterial biocides, and stabilizers.

Browse Formulations →

3. Toothpaste

Fluoride actives, biomimetic hydroxyapatite, polishing abrasives, and foaming agents.

Browse Formulations →

4. House Cleaning Products

Sodium hypochlorite bleach, hydrogen peroxide oxidizers, surface degreasers, and disinfectants.

Browse Formulations →

5. Facial Cleanser / Face Wash

Non-ionic glucoside gels, paraben preservatives, UV filters, and skin-identical humectants.

Browse Formulations →

6. Deodorant / Perfume

Quaternary ammonium compounds (BAK), synthetic fragrance fixatives, and mineral alternatives.

Browse Formulations →

7. Detergent / Cloth Washing Soap

Linear alkylbenzene sulfonates (LAS), washing sodas, optical brighteners, and citrate builders.

Browse Formulations →

8. Dishwashing / Utensil Cleaning

Grease-cutting anionic/non-ionic surfactants, enzyme stabilizers, and residue buffers.

Browse Formulations →

Academic & Educational Disclaimer

This website is an academic demonstration developed for educational purposes to raise awareness of consumer chemical formulations and toxicological standards. The information provided here is derived from public regulatory databases (ECHA, CIR, US EPA, WHO) and does not constitute medical, dermatological, or diagnostic advice.

Chemical Awareness

An academic college initiative dedicated to chemical transparency, ingredient literacy, and public health awareness.
